title: Pullback realization on strict quotient models
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and arbitrary schemes, with independent site and coefficient universes. Use the actual coherent reduction/total-limit adjunction $S$, its system derived tensor and canonical reduction presentations [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus], the completed integral operations on good flat-term K-flat representatives [lem-pur-integral-operations-well-defined], and a projection- and resolution-normalized Roos realization [def-sf-primitive-tensor-realization-data]. For every morphism $f:X\to Y$, reduction datum $S$ on $Y$ and normalized Roos realization $\rho$ on $X$, there exists a natural isomorphism $r:\widehat{Lf^*}K\cong\mathcal L_X(F_f(S(K)))$, where $F_f$ is the exact whole-system derived inverse image [def-trf-integral-comparison-sequence-systems]. It satisfies the existing predicate $\operatorname{PullModel}(f,S,\rho,r)$: the actual coherent reduction presentation of every good input, the strict tower isomorphism whose finite components are given by the unit-normalized inverse-image evaluation comparison, and equality of the completed representative map with its restricted-tower Roos realization. No assertion on the counit or beta comparisons is included.

proof.text: Use the actual coherent reduction presentation on good complexes. QuotientSystemFlatModels and quotientSystemInverseImage give a strict inverse-image quotient tower. Exact sequence inverse image and its unit-normalized evaluation identify every finite component and transition with the prescribed integral pullback tower.

Apply normalized Roos functor descent to the restricted inverse-image tower. Identify the descended completed functor with integralDerivedPullback using its representative comparison and localization uniqueness. The representative component equation gives exactly PullModel. The given resolution normalization identifies the Roos comparison on all inputs.

lean.statement:
theorem primitiveCounitPullbackRealization
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    {X Y : Scheme.{t}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (S : CoefficientDerivedSystemReduction l E Y)
    (ρ : PrimitiveCounit.RoosRealization l E X) :
    ∃ r : integralDerivedPullback l E f ≅
      S.reduction ⋙ PrimitiveCounit.pull l E f ⋙ coefficientSequenceLimit l E X,
      PrimitiveCounit.PullModel l E f S ρ r
